ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
Public Improvements Reimbursement Agreement (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Reimbursement Agreement between the City of Vista and Charter Sycamore Pointe, LLC; and
2.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the Resolution, Agreement, and Notices of Encumbrance in the County Recorder's Office.
PH2.
Target Commercial Center (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , certifying the Final Environmental Impact Report and adopting Environmental Findings pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, and the Statement of Overriding Considerations, and the Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program for the Target Commercial Center at 3150 Business Park Drive; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , granting a Special Use Permit, inclusive of a Plot Plan, to allow the sale of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption, and approving a Tentative Parcel Map for the Target Commercial Center at 3150 Business Park Drive.
REMARKS
R1.

R2.
